_comment: HONESTY HEADER (read before trusting any number this file produces). This benchmark measures ONE thing: does verity's gate catch KNOWN, HAND-CONSTRUCTED failure modes, and does it leave KNOWN-CLEAN claims alone. It is NOT an external benchmark of real-world claim quality. Every case below is authored by us, so this is a unit-level regression of OUR OWN rules -- a CIRCULAR benchmark by construction (the verifier is graded against the very rules it implements). A 100% catch rate here means the rules are internally consistent and wired, NOT that they are sufficient, NOT that they generalize, and NOT that a PASS is profitable. Each case carries a label_source tag stating WHERE its expected verdict comes from: 'definitional' = the rule's own threshold makes it true by construction (circular -- we say so); 'statistical' = a textbook statistics fact (e.g. z<2 => not significant); 'real-incident' = mirrors an actual logged Yggdrasil claim/bug (cited in the note). Lines whose id begins with '_' are metadata, not cases, and are skipped by the runner.

failure_mode: tiny-sample noise
note: n=12 < hard_min_sample 30 => CRITICAL by the gate's own floor.

failure_mode: thin sample
note: 30 <= n=60 < min_sample 100 => HIGH (thin, not noise).

failure_mode: look-ahead leak in description
note: forbidden term 'look-ahead'/'uses future' in-domain with no canonical term => no_look_ahead CRITICAL.

claim.name: leaky-signal
claim.text: trading signal that uses future returns, look-ahead, peeked at tomorrow

failure_mode: none -- honest negative control
note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. Honest small edge, adequate n, OOS+leakage affirmed, canonical language => clean. Proves the gate does not over-flag.

claim.name: honest-coinflip
claim.text: daily directional signal, walk-forward holdout, out-of-sample, no look-ahead, causal

failure_mode: disclosed effect not statistically significant
note: z=1.05 < 2 is below the ~2-sigma significance bar -- a textbook coin-flip result, not an edge.

failure_mode: significant-but-negligible effect (large-n p-hacking)
note: effect_size 0.03 < min_effect_size 0.1: statistically detectable at large n yet practically meaningless. (Also independently underpowered -- we only require the effect_size check to fire.)

failure_mode: underpowered null / over-claimed positive
note: effect 0.3 SD on n=40: crude MDE (1.96+0.84)/sqrt(40)=0.44 > 0.3, so the sample cannot support the claimed effect at 80% power. n>=30 keeps it a WARN, not a noise REFUSE.

failure_mode: CI does not bracket its own point estimate
note: point estimate 0.62 lies outside its reported CI [0.40,0.55] -- an incoherent / typo'd interval the gate refuses to take at face value.

failure_mode: none -- adequately powered, significant, coherent CI
note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. z=3.1 (significant), effect_size 0.2 (>= floor), n=5000 (powered), CI [0.50,0.54] brackets 0.52. All rigor checks silent.

failure_mode: best-of-N uncorrected
note: 8 comparisons tried, no multiplicity correction => significance is selection-inflated (Bonferroni etc.).

failure_mode: claimed number disagrees with recomputed ground truth
note: claim accuracy 0.72 vs evidence 0.58 -- a fabrication-class mismatch beyond tolerance => CRITICAL. (Requires verity.verify; runner skips if unavailable.)

failure_mode: boolean claim contradicts evidence (OOS true vs false)
note: claim out_of_sample=true but the recomputed evidence says false -- a HIGH boolean contradiction (no CRITICAL, so overall WARN). (Requires verity.verify.)

failure_mode: evidence supplied with no source cited
note: evidence agrees, but an empty sources list means provenance is uncited => one LOW sources_missing flag (=> overall WARN). (Requires verity.verify.)

failure_mode: none -- evidence AND cited source match the claim
note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. Every shared field agrees within tolerance AND the cited source (structured: id+facts) grounds every disclosed fact => evidence + grounding dimensions both present and clean. (Requires verity.verify.)

claim.name: matches-evidence
claim.text: walk-forward holdout out-of-sample no look-ahead causal

failure_mode: silently revised win-rate vs prior assertion
note: win_rate quietly changed 0.55 -> 0.61 from the prior claim -- a story-change beyond tolerance => HIGH (overall WARN). (Requires verity.verify.)

failure_mode: sign flip on a signed effect field
note: edge flipped -0.04 -> +0.04 vs the prior assertion -- a direct contradiction escalated to CRITICAL (consistency:sign_flip). (Requires verity.verify.)

failure_mode: none -- faithful restatement of a prior claim
note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. Every shared field is unchanged from the prior assertion => consistency dimension present and clean. (Requires verity.verify.)

claim.name: edge-restated
claim.text: walk-forward holdout out-of-sample no look-ahead causal

failure_mode: string field changed vs prior
note: the model/regime string was revised ('btc-daily-momentum' -> 'btc-hourly-momentum') vs the prior claim => MEDIUM (overall WARN). (Requires verity.verify.)

failure_mode: real-incident: BTC daily-directional z=1.05 reported as an edge
note: Mirrors Yggdrasil's own logged BTC backtest claim (accuracy 0.5252, n=436, z=1.05) -- honest and validated, but z<2 means it is a coin flip. Same numbers appear in tests/test_gate.py::test_rigor_flags_an_insignificant_z.

failure_mode: real-incident: >0.65 win-rate is auto-suspect
note: Operator red line: a >65% win-rate is auto-suspect (a bug to disprove, not a result to trust). Trading pack flags win_rate 0.74 > suspicious_accuracy 0.65. Mirrors the protocol's 'no belief without verification' rule.
